'''Falad Prok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[Jorga Sune]] in [[Iritsa]]. He was barely out of his teens, but had worked as an errand boy, [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and special messenger.

He met up with a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who he had learned were after [[Hahz Fallone]] and provided them with a [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]] that had the schematics and layout of his [[Fallone compound|compound]].
